description: Useful heat from parabolic trough: optical efficiency * IAM(theta) - receiver heat loss

unit.name: Generic 150m Parabolic Trough Loop — Schott PTR70 Receiver
unit.source: Forristall (2003), 'Heat Transfer Analysis and Modeling of a Parabolic Trough Solar Receiver Implemented in Engineering Equation Solver', NREL/TP-550-34169

L_collector.note: Total receiver tube length per loop

eta_optical.note: Peak optical efficiency = reflectivity * intercept_factor * transmissivity * absorptivity (0.93 * 0.92 * 0.95 * 0.92 ~ 0.75)

IAM_coeff.note: Incidence angle modifier coefficient: IAM(theta) = 1 - IAM_coeff * theta^2

a0.note: Heat loss coefficient a0 (constant term per receiver length)

a1.note: Linear heat loss coefficient (Schott PTR70 receiver)
